message_text: Where is the financial aid office located? The website says Miller Hall but there's no building called that on the campus map.
I apologize for the outdated information. Miller Hall was renamed to Student Services Building last year. It's located at the intersection of University Ave and 3rd Street.
That's confusing. The whole website has outdated building names.
You're right, and we appreciate the feedback. The web team is currently updating all campus location references.
Well at least you're aware of it. Thanks for the directions.
Thank you for your patience! The office is open Monday-Friday, 8:30am-4:30pm.
